content.text: I'm working on a research paper for my information design class and I need some background on The Visual Display of Quantitative Information (1983) by Edward R. Tufte — it's a foundational book on data visualization and statistical graphics. I'm looking for a summary of its main arguments and principles, how it was received when it came out, and any biographical info on Tufte that explains why he became such an influential figure in this field. Can you help me pull that together?
